items.title: 68427_Harry Edison oral history interview
items.q: And I recorded with Bing Crosby, Jerry Lewis, Billy Daniels, Ella Fitzgerald, oh, I recorded with everybody.

ctx.x: That was when Capitol was the hot label.
Hot label, right. And I recorded with Bing Crosby, Jerry Lewis, Billy Daniels, Ella Fitzgerald, oh, I recorded with everybody. I was really busy out here, you

know. That's the reason I stayed out here and didn't go back to New York, because I was doing the same thing out here as the guys were doing in New York. But, you know, they were going from one date to another, so was I, you know. And I was really, really busy out here.
